subject: general
question: In which year will India host the G20 Summit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2023**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India will host the G20 Summit in the year **2023**.
 
• The G20 Summit is an international forum for governments and central bank governors from 19 countries and the European Union.
 
• It addresses global economic issues such as international financial stability, climate change mitigation, and sustainable development.
 
• India's presidency of the G20 will provide an opportunity to influence the global economic agenda and promote its interests on various international issues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The G20 was founded in 1999 in response to the financial crises of the late 1990s.
 
• The members of the G20 represent about 85% of the global GDP, over 75% of global trade, and two-thirds of the world's population.
 
• The G20 Summit is held annually, and the host country rotates among its members.
 
• Key issues discussed at G20 Summits include economic growth, international trade, and the regulation of financial markets.
 
• In recent years, the G20 has also focused on issues such as climate change, global health, and sustainable development.
